products.title: Adult Miller Tee
products.body: The Miller Tee is an elevated take on an everyday wardrobe staple. This classic crew neck tee features pleats through the front bodice, adding subtle texture and interest to the relaxed silhouette. Choose from three lengths—Crop, Modest Crop, or Top—and three sleeve options, including two short sleeve lengths and a long sleeve. For the back bodice, choose between a simple back or coordinating pleated details. With multiple options to mix and match, the Miller Tee is an easy-to-wear staple that works just as well on its own as it does layered under your favorite cardigan, sweater, or jacket. Match your little and pick up the Kids and/or Babies Juliet too! Options include: -Petite, Regular & Tall -Full Coverage & Cheeky Bum Cutlines -Crew & Low Scoop Front Necklines -High and Low Scoop Back Necklines -5 Different sleeve lengths & a FLUTTER option -Elastic or Leg Bands -Snap Crotch -Mini & Midi Circle Skirt Pattern INCLUDED! **BONUS! Wanna add a circle sleeve for some extra flair? Grab the FREE circle sleeve add-on HERE ! Fabric and Notions Recommended Fabrics: *Stretch knits with 50% stretch with 4 way stretch

products.title: Kids Juliet
products.body: The Juliet is a leotard, bodysuit and the perfect dance companion. Wear it at your next competition or recital, around the town, at the pool or under your favorite Sassy skirt. With its beautiful low back it has many options including 4 sleeve lengths, flutters, a bow back, and leg bands OR elastic. The hacks will be endless and the blog posts accompanying this pattern will make it your go to pattern. And if just the leotard wasn’t enough it includes the pattern for the banded tutu skirt as well. Make it with tulle, chiffon or leave the layer out all together and use just the lining for a cute woven skirt. The banded tutu skirt is meant to be full and hit just below the knees. Fabric and Notions Recommended Fabrics: *Stretch knits with 50% 4 way stretch
